items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of electric wheelchair
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Entscheidung innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse, Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen.
items.computation: Letter (Bescheid) dated Friday 2026-11-20, sent by post within Germany. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a written administrative act sent by post is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after it was handed to the post, unless actually received later; 2026-11-20 + 3 days = 2026-11-23 (Monday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so Bekanntgabe = 2026-11-23. The one-month Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 2026-11-24, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of Bekanntgabe: 2026-12-23. That date is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. Final deadline: 2026-12-23.
